_comment: Hand-entered events, re-applied on every sweep. Use for incidents the feeds missed. Required: slug, category (ransomware | data_breach | ddos | cyberattack | exploited_vulnerability | outage), headline, started_at (UTC), alleged_cause, sources, and either scores {reach, criticality, impact, duration} (0-3 each; coverage is counted from sources) or a fixed severity (1-5). Optional: target, resolved_at, ongoing, attributed_to, detail, summary. Delete an entry to remove it from the site. 'overrides' pins the severity of any incident whose headline contains 'match', e.g. {"match": "Slack: Trouble loading", "severity": 2, "note": "partial, no wider impact"}.

events.headline: FAA orders nationwide ground stop after communications failure
events.alleged_cause: Federal officials blamed a newly installed router, part of an upgrade from copper to fiber-optic telecom lines, that flooded the system with connection attempts; DHS said it was not a cyberattack. Root cause still under investigation.
events.detail: Began in the Chicago area and spread to multiple control centers; flight disruptions lasted into Nov 15
